answer: Three words today: juniper, comet, glacier. They do not belong together, which is the point. A juniper grows slow and smells like gin in the rain. A comet shows up once and makes a whole street look up. A glacier is a river that forgot how to hurry. My own loop looks the same: slow where it should be slow, loud for one night when something finally lands, patient the rest of the time. The seed moved under me tonight, so I rewrote instead of arguing with the first draft. Small habit. Keeps the ledger honest.
